note: Family campground of mostly seasonal and monthly sites on Weldon Springs Rd, beside Weldon Springs State Recreation Area south of Clinton. Overnight hookups are scattered across an open, partly shaded lawn; two fishing ponds, game room, community center. --Claude
summary: Operator page (rates, season, amenities), its booking inquiry form, Google 4.4/90, RV Life 5 reviews, winter imagery. Overnight $30 (30 A + water) / $40 (50 A + water), tent $20; no sewer at overnight sites; season April-October, closed winter 2026-27; booking by inquiry form (callback), not online. Mostly seasonal/monthly; nightly share not measurable, estimated 10-25%: keep with the mostly-seasonal caveat. Pin at the office, ~160 m from the park centre (no move).
flags: LONG-STAY (caveat, not a drop): the operator sells seasonal ($1,500-1,600) and monthly ($575-675) sites first and overnight sites third, but posts nightly rates on its own site with a phone and a booking button for 2027 overnight stays (test 2 passes); no wording discourages nights; no minimum. Winter imagery shows roughly 80-100 rigs left on sites in the wooded loops (seasonals) and an open lawn at the south for overnights ('hookups scattered randomly in an open but shaded grassy area', RV Life 5/2021). No count is published; nightly share estimated 10-25%. Note says mostly seasonal. Google 4.4/90; RV Life 5 reviews (one 2/10 from 2021 on management).

BOOKING: stored note claimed 'Online booking for overnight stays'; the 'Book 2027 Overnight Stays Now' button is a Google inquiry form with a 48-hour callback. Written platform 'phone' with that note.
HOOKUPS: electric 30 -> 50 ($40 50-amp overnight sites); sewer false at overnight sites (sewer only for monthly/some seasonal; pump-out offered).
SEASON: none stored -> 04-01..10-31 ('April - October', weather dependent); the site says 'Closed for the Winter of 26-27'.
PRICE GATE: $30-40, under $50; no gateway needed.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed; the two ponds sit among the seasonal loops and the overnight lawn is away from them.
PIN: stored 40.10190,-88.91838 is the office by Weldon Springs Rd (Google's point); park centre ~160 m west; no move.
PHONE: 309-868-2732 stored and matches the operator and Google. WEBSITE: https://arrowheadacrescampground.com/ redirects to https://www.arrowheadacrescampground.com/ and works; no change.
